output.sentence_text: If you print out the total number of parameters, you will see that the number of parameters is equal to 163 million.
Adding 38.4 million embedding parameters, 85.2 million Transformer parameters, and 38.4 million final-layer parameters gives about 162 million parameters in total.
This is why the model being trained is on the order of more than 100 million parameters.
The gap between 163 million parameters in this implementation and 124 million parameters in the smallest GPT-2 comes from weight tying.
For this model, 163 million parameters require around 600 megabytes of space.
Assuming each parameter is a 32-bit float taking 4 bytes, the size is computed by multiplying the total number of parameters by 4, which gives about 620 MB.
